subject: general
question:
**A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.**

He said to me, "You should work harder."

options.text: He said me that I should work harder.
He told me that I should work harder.
He told me that you should work harder.
He told that I should work harder.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He told me that I should work harder.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"You should work harder" becomes "I should work harder"**
 
 
• Pronoun "You" is converted to "I" to match the perspective of the person being addressed.
 
• Verb "should work" remains unchanged as it is modal and does not require tense changes.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "said to me"
 
• Converted to: "told me," which is more appropriate for indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is removed and replaced with a reporting clause.
 
• Quotation marks are omitted as the sentence is converted to indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is structured to convey meaning without altering the original intent.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He told me that I should work harder."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said me that I should work harder."
 
 
• Incorrect use of "said me" instead of "told me." The verb "said" must be followed by "to" when addressing someone.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He told me that you should work harder."
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun "you" instead of "I," which changes the perspective of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He told that I should work harder."
 
 
• Missing the indirect object "me," which makes the sentence incomplete.
